overnightRisk: Next report is ~02:00 COT. Friday close into the weekend means thin liquidity and no US cash session until Monday. A resting stop at 82,500 is the only overnight protection; 1H RSI 41 and a negative 1H MACD histogram argue for caution. Longs are mildly crowded (ratio 1.31), so a break lower can cascade.
